_doc: Gig objectives (Objective.make): each kind names its rules module in src/tactical/objectives/ and carries its tuning. Gig templates (gigs.json) map to these kinds through Campaign.OBJECTIVES. A new kind is a new module plus an entry here; Encounter, the HUD and the view only talk to the Objective interface. Numbers are HOUSE-RULE unless cited.

assassinate.name: Assassination
assassinate._vip: The mark: a Night City civilian (NC2045 civilian blocks, data/rules/npcs.json) who fits the target faction's kind; a kind with none fields the faction's own Lieutenant (Mini Boss at security 2+).

rescue.name: Rescue
rescue._captive: The captive: one of Night City's civilians (any NC2045 civilian block, Recruit.civilian_blocks) under one of these names.
